notes.title: Live Stream with the Devs
notes.content:
[h1]We will be streaming Bot Gaiden on Thursday June 18th at 8pm EDT, join us at https://www.twitch.tv/foulmoustache[/h1]



We will be available to answer all of your questions as we play through stages and demo single player, multi player, typical progress as well as gold-level speedrunning!
